title: Score refresh, district proposals and production use different update gates
statement: CityManager StartTurn resets per-city off-turn/job flags; readiness-gated DoOffTurn schedules City Analysis that loops all stored plots. Full matching-priority activation aggregates future buildings and checks opportunities. A live district event tree can prevent a new GetBestDistrict call, and ordinary QueueNextBuild is gated on an empty queue.

limits: Outer virtual scheduler and every event path not exhaustively traced; not a universal exact selector-call count/calendar cadence. New-city initialization can trigger extra analysis; threat interruption is a separate guarded path. Native analysis cycle need not align with CSC global inactive scan.

title: Building income has a first-prerequisite-depth multiplier before discounting
statement: BuildingValue52b900 follows the first prerequisite at each level and counts depth d. An early normalized benefit subtotal is multiplied by1+2*d, then normalized maintenance is subtracted and the resulting income enters discounted-stream calculations. Later amenity, housing, power and modifier additions are separate.
scope: Fresh decompilation of exact pinned XP2 BuildingValue52b900 lines438-465; prerequisite vector+1f8/+200 independently identified through the native SQL loader in the IZ study. Code arithmetic gives factors1/3/5 at depths0/1/2 for that subtotal.

Relevance of hidden CSC prerequisite buildings is an inference needing component observation, not measured attribution of the pilot gains.

title: Plot purchases have targeted preparation and opportunistic economic routes
statement: A district preparation tree can submit a PurchasePlotContract for its exact location; Economic TryPurchasePlot seeks the lowest positive city quote before native legality checks. Separately PurchasePlots uses each city's cached frontier-resource acquisition target, selected from improvement forecasts and a feature heuristic. Both use plot/slush savings and native command legality; the requested route has a lower earmarked-plot-fund hurdle.
scope: Pinned XP2 Economic457120/458530/459090 and PurchasePlotNode55db70/55ed80/55dee0, contract3f9010/3fa260, CityBuild AnalyzeCityPlots3de990; exact Execute/Validate thunk bytes3f82c0/3fa880 and0.5/0.25 constants; shipped BehaviorTrees.xml and Leaders.xml.
limits: No new purchase executed. Full outer scheduler not exhausted; no extra N-turn cooldown found within inspected routines. Routine target selection is order-sensitive rather than strict global maximum. Earlier Hague/Pokrovka logs say Purchase Plot success with Not Buying anything; they do not prove spending or explain the precise pre-scan exclusion.

limits: Independent proxy is a delivery experiment, not selected CSC release architecture. Actual Workshop upload/subscription and acceptance untested. Diagnostic driver postassert exited1 because reset counters were sampled too late; original result preserved and42 writes recovered from package logs offline. statement: Vanilla Water Mill uses RequiresAdjacentRiver, loaded into building159 bit08. Ordinary BuildQueue precompute0f61c0 tests the city's own plot, not the prerequisite district. statement: On the pinned XP2 target, six read-only boundaries correlate BuildingValue, its own ModifierValue and direct amenities with exact AnalyzeModifier descriptors and nested base-yield results. All88 active BM roots observed in each city, all148 mutable district cells and both prerequisite vectors reconcile. Return sites distinguish own building subtotals from unrelated helper subroutes.

Before-interval source presence is distinguished from callback contexts. Negative remaining terms, specialist attribution, CityCenter population/export consumers and exact hidden structural income are unmeasured. No scoring output changed and no CE API added.

statement: The 528310 fixed-point income kernel and 528660 interval wrapper supply shared timing. Explicit plot yield at 485a10 discounts the stream, halves it, then normalizes with default weights. title: District site valuation subtracts the remaining value of an intact improvement
statement: The district NetValue branch subtracts the shared improvement Value and the signed resource-helper result for a removal quantity of minus one. It separately credits positive district-creation yields when applicable. Improvement value uses weighted yields, relevant plot and city effects, and a discounted interval beginning at district readiness. A missing or pillaged improvement skips this branch.

Earlier visible-resource harvest eligibility can reject the site before this branch. The debit precedes later building aggregation.
limits: Static evidence. The exact debit in a played city, ordinary terrain and citizen reallocation elsewhere in the score, and the specific value recognized for displaced CSC supplier effects are unmeasured.

title: A patched stock district bid changed selection but expired during preparation

The causal comparison covers selection and preparation, while later observations describe treatment follow-through. Recurring Stage 2 bids, completed construction, research causality and patched CE delivery remain separate.

title: Current civic turns remaining and the AI's research-route estimate are distinct
statement: Gameplay GetTurnsLeftOnCurrentCivic derives a turns estimate from the active civic, current culture yield, cost, progress and carried culture. The UI GetTurnsToProgressCivic returns an indexed cache entry. CultureAi::EstimatedTimeToResearch reads a separate requested-civic planning row and can add time remaining on the active civic.

title: A city can refresh Bakers values while an existing district tree blocks selection
statement: CheckForDistrict reaches GetBestDistrict only with a free district tree slot and a configured tree. A fresh positive district-site score can appear while the city continues preparing a previously selected district. That preparation and the actual production queue can be occupied by different items.

In an isolated CSC Online turn 8–9 control, London player 4 city 65536 recalculated Bakers at plot 2568 to 11930 Q8 and made no scoped GetBestDistrict call. The Holy Site tree was active, with Astrology contract 34 and a reservation on Base plot 2421. The improvement tree reserved candidate 2420 separately. Great Bath was receiving production. Zero writes and verified restoration.

A locked-but-near civic bid, a recurring policy, Mill and Granary construction, supplier improvement, and the working Stage 2 chain require separate evidence.

title: Boston committed to a district over a Bakers supplier before the production order
statement: Boston's district selector and tree committed to a Campus on the tracked Base plot before its queue selected the construction contract. The later physical observation showed the Campus and the deposit gone. The district selector requires a score above the effective reservation value, so an improvement reservation does not itself preserve a supplier.

The plot still contained its Base deposit at the turn-33 boundary. The same contract entered production on turn 33, with Campus and no deposit observed at turn 36. Ghidra GetBestDistrict at 3e4a50 checks the effective reservation and current best. Its native default at b66cb0 is −2559744 Q8.
limits: One exact tracked supplier. The later observation did not enumerate every other neighbor. Last-viable classification, an effective deduction, hard exclusion, and a generic retained-chain policy require separate tests.

title: A technology goal and the actual queued research step can differ
statement: AI Research::QueueNextTech compares technology analysis rows and submits the selected row's immediately researchable step after a CanResearch check. TechResearchContract executes IncreasePriority on the row's value rather than directly setting the active research. GetBestTechsToResearch's direct callers are Grand Strategic cache routines.

QueueNextTech at 4fa9a0, comparator at 4f60d0, SetResearchingTech at 336230, TechResearchContract Execute at 3f82e0, IncreasePriority at 4f9810, and cache reader at 4f95b0. The contract increases the analysis row's +0x14 value subject to its guard.
limits: Static route and storage evidence. Comparator flags are not fully attributed. The Boston run researched naturally and no custom technology score, contract, immediate choice or completion was induced.

Its existing improvement job completed the Pasture on the protected deposit. Native research and production subsequently supplied the Granary and Water Mill.

Matched source and reservation ID, zero further writes and verified restoration.

title: A civic boost's Farm job can clear a functioning material supplier
statement: A native Feudalism boost Farm job reserved the protected Cattle site. Its assigned Builder removed the Pasture, then harvested the deposit through Clear Plot. This loss occurred without a district on the tile and requires a work-admission decision separate from district protection.

Native UnitOperations records REMOVE_IMPROVEMENT turn 52 and HARVEST_RESOURCE turn 53. Cattle and Pasture absent at turn 54 with district=-1. Ghidra ClearPlotNode Execute at 55d970 confirms its removal-first and harvest branches.
limits: One boost job and site. Exact candidate ranking and a scoped admission intervention remain to be verified. A Farm completion is not established. No research changes were made in this continuation.

title: Boost and ordinary improvement work admit locations through separate native callers
statement: The empire-wide boost branch of DecodeTrigger skips a city if its native improvement location is null. CheckForImprovement separately skips a new city tree when that location is null. Withholding only the exact protected Farm result at both call sites prevented the destructive work in the retained Boston replay.

Farm on plot 796 withheld once on the boost route and six times on the ordinary route through turn 66. The original boost result Boston 27094 Q8 was withheld while Washington plot 1168 at 15698 Q8 remained available. The boost-only arm removed Pasture on the ordinary route; the combined arm kept it through every sample and achieved Storekeeper at 63 and 66.
limits: Scoped return veto for one player, improvement and plot. It skips that city's unsafe top Farm candidate and does not choose the city's runner-up. Other improvement routes, a reusable dynamic value adjustment and perpetual retention were not qualified.

The upstream control's process memory confirmed its shared event detour replaced bytes inside a native instruction in the faulting loop. The stock hotfix replay reached turn 2 from the same save.

title: The corrected shared CE profile loads and carries district scores on the patched Steam DX11 build
statement: Matching the event entry and shared globals between the exact DX11 images enabled both a compatibility-only CE control and the guarded district-score candidate to load the previously failing save. The candidate reproduced the early and late writes and the subsequent Bakers selection and preparation.

title: Native Builder location ranking can skip a protected candidate and still return a lower-scoring site
statement: An exact-row filter at the improvement score floor left the native scan in control. It returned no Boston location in the first boost pass and later returned a lower-scoring Boston plot. The Cattle Pasture stayed intact through Storekeeper activation.

Eleven candidate evaluations filtered. Ordinary calls returned plot 794 at score zero after filtering scores of 4054 to 6109 Q8 for plot 796. Storekeeper operated at turns 63 and 66.
limits: One scoped Frida probe. Returning a plot is separate from reserving it and completing work. The observed turn-58 Farm operation on plot 719 used a higher-scoring option that could already win that pass. Existing reservations, other Builder entry points and the CE implementation remain open.

title: A whole-function improvement score feeds the native Builder ranking cache
statement: The row evaluator calls improvement NetValue with explicit improvement, plot and city arguments. It copies the returned integer unchanged into the improvement score array. The ranking floor is also the ineligible score used by the evaluator.
scope: XP2 hotfix SHA 092abfbb. Row evaluator 3e2aa0, call at 3e3423, improvement NetValue 52a8c0, row score array at 0x30, native floor −2559744 Q8 from b66cb0. The compared hotfix and reference bytes match.
limits: A changed result affects future reads of that cached value. A new publication does not recalculate stale scores or cancel already assigned jobs. ClearPlotNode 55d970 and BuildImprovementNode 551360 can reach execution without consulting this score.

title: An existing pillaged building can enter ordinary city production as a repair
statement: CityBuild::BuildBuilding accepts an absent or pillaged building, checks CanConstruct and issues the native building-type Build request. Builder improvement repair has a separate operation path.
scope: Windows XP2 hotfix code matched to the Ghidra reference. BuildBuilding 3df040 tests HasBuilding and IsPillaged, calls CanConstruct f7100 and builds the request at 6834a0. Boston's stock Mill completed through both a retained contract and ordinary fallback production in separate damage states. BuildImprovementNode uses its own native Repair request.
limits: The traces verify the Water Mill cases. They do not establish how quickly arbitrary pillaged buildings are proposed, selected and completed, or cover a pillaged host district.

title: The ordinary building forecast already gives pillaged buildings a repair multiplier
statement: The ordinary NetValue caller passes sentinel coordinates. An existing pillaged building triggers a doubling of the computed result, which is stored in the city building array. The tile-specific Wonder caller passes real coordinates and stores a separate plot score.
scope: Patched Windows XP2 with matching reference code. Ordinary call 3e3edd and Wonder call 3e419a both reach building NetValue 52a050. GetBestBuilding 3e4710 consumes the city-center row's building array.
limits: This multiplier does not establish a positive score, a winning bid, a queue entry or displacement of ongoing production. A separate live observation is required for Boston's damaged Water Mill.

title: An old improvement reservation ID can fail to resolve and leave the tile available
statement: AnalyzeTerrain and the improvement location selector skip a row only when its nonempty reservation resolves to a live object. An occupied ordinary improvement tree slot is a separate gate on submitting new work.
scope: Patched XP2 Windows. AnalyzeTerrain at 3dec40 and GetBestLocationFor at 3e5750 call manager Find at 4019f0. In Boston's controlled Pasture-loss replay, old ID 4521998 resolved false during the first six checks, while tree slot 10027025 remained occupied. The later Irrigation claim resolved true.
limits: A free row is still subject to its score, legal improvement and worker availability. The probe does not establish when an old live job expires or whether a mod can cancel it safely.

title: Clear Plot has a worker-readiness decision before operation submission
statement: ClearPlotNode::Update resolves the bound plot and selects a worker with charges and acceptable reachability. A ready result retains the worker ID. ClearPlotNode::Execute uses that ID and submits the removal or harvest request.
scope: Patched XP2 Windows. Update 55eaf0 clears the selected worker field at node offset 0x40. Ready path 55ed62 records the unit ID and returns 1. The other paths return 2 or 3. Execute 55d970 submits the configured harvest through its dispatcher call at 55da77 when no improvement remains.
limits: Static code identifies the gate. AI-C074 tests one matched native failure and verifies reuse of the site. It does not establish general tree lifecycle, retry behavior or coverage of other operation routes.

title: An ordinary production winner can fail and skip the runner-up categories
statement: The default category comparison in QueueNextBuild selects a building, unit or project. In the observed branch, a failed project start fell directly into generic unit selection without retrying the building or the ordinary unit candidate.
scope: Patched XP2 Windows. QueueNextBuild at 3e8190 compares the category operands at 3e8741. In the matched control, BuildProject at 3df4b0 failed CanAdvance at 3df4e5 before operation validation. The false return at 3e88e5 preceded the generic unit return at 3e899f.
limits: This is one default branch after earlier contract handling. The specific condition inside CanAdvance, other failed operations and the economic value of the generic unit remain unresolved.

title: Gameplay and UI use different Lua build-queue bindings
statement: Gameplay HasBeenPlaced takes a production discriminator and a second value. The UI cache accepts a production hash as its first argument. Gameplay CanProduce is registered to a stub on the inspected build.
scope: Patched XP2 Windows. Gameplay PushMethods at 6c9860 registers HasBeenPlaced at 6ca220 and CanProduce at 6ca200. Discriminator DISTRICT hashes to 0x080d3734 and selects the district-index overload at ff570. The UI cache registers its own CanProduce at 68b9e0. In a normal-start CSC game, using a district hash as the lone Gameplay HasBeenPlaced argument caused 219 errors.
limits: The Gameplay registration explains the observed failure. Reusing UI-cache legality from Gameplay requires an explicit bridge and checks against authoritative current plot state.

title: Civic queue choices use full goal values and a separate immediately legal step
statement: QueueNextCivic compares CivicAnalysis rows, reads the winning row's next step and checks CanProgress before appending it. CivicResearchContract adds to a full Q8 goal value; it does not queue the civic itself.
scope: Patched XP2 Windows. QueueNextCivic 418860 calls comparator 40de20. The 0x50-byte row has goal index at +0x08, owned flag +0x0c, solo and full Q8 at +0x10 and +0x14, estimated turns +0x18, and next step +0x1c. Comparator prefers unowned rows and avoids the excluded step, then compares full Q8 when the signed product of estimated turns is positive. CivicResearchContract::Execute 3f8250 calls IncreasePriority 416630.
limits: Static decision path and units. No calibrated Feudalism bid, advance date, or Storekeeper benefit is established. Full value is rebuilt by CalculateFullValue and can be sorted for other consumers.

title: City founding annexes eligible radius-one plots before additional starting acquisitions
statement: Founding enumerates radius one and annexes unowned tiles and same-owner tiles without a district. It skips foreign tiles and same-owner tiles with a district, then uses ordinary next-plot selection for any remaining starting acquisitions.
scope: Patched Steam XP2 code matched the Ghidra reference. City::Culture::DoFoundCity at 11be40 calls AcquirePlots at 11b000. Its founding traversal uses the radius-one ring helper at 4fa40 and 4f9c0 and the callback at 11a290 through thunk 11d670.
limits: This describes normal founding rather than every later border state. The radius-one footprint of a proposed Quarter and its more distant material deposit may have different owners. No CSC purchase policy was tested.

title: City building requirements and building yield changes resolve the receiving player's replacement
statement: The inspected CityHasBuilding test resolves the requested index through the subject city's owner's replacement table before testing presence and pillage. AdjustBuildingYieldChange resolves the recipient index through the same table before applying the yield change.
scope: Patched Windows XP2 Ghidra reference. CityHasBuilding::Test 832c30 and AdjustBuildingYieldChange::Apply 871f30 use the player-city table at +0x150. AddBuildingReplacementOverride 264110 corroborates the table identity.
limits: Specific native requirement and effect paths. Source modifier attachments and other requirements may handle replacements differently. No live Granary replacement or exchange was tested here.

title: A building contract can finish through the separate economic purchase path
statement: UnitRequestContract's economic Execute calls TryPurchaseBuilding. That path compares native PresentValueOf against normalized Gold cost, applies eligibility and spending gates, and can complete the same request through the ordinary purchase command.
scope: Patched XP2 Windows. Economic Execute 3f8850 calls TryPurchaseBuilding 458d00, which reads building PresentValueOf 3e7e50 and submits Purchase::MakeRequest 6809a0. Trebizond's Granary purchase carried its admitted contract ID.
limits: Scoped building-contract route. Exact Gold cost and live threshold operands were not measured, and other purchasing routes were not evaluated.

title: Find Available Unit recruits existing units separately from production and movement
statement: FindAvailableUnitNode checks units already controlled by the behavior and can call RecruitUnits with the control identity and effective request priority. The first recruitment pool requires no controller. Both pools exclude processed-turn and delayed-death units. The inspected typed-target evaluator branch ranks type priority first and uses plot distance to break ties.
scope: Ghidra XP2 reference 324c51e9 and live hotfix 092abfbb with identical .text. FindAvailableUnitNode Update RVA 554b10, RecruitUnits 403190, evaluator 553570 and callback table entry a0ce08 matched.
limits: One typed-target evaluator branch. Plot distance does not establish route viability. The callback that supplies the second pool and the filter that affected a specific Builder require further evidence.

title: Growth and district Great Person points have distinct native valuation inputs
statement: The city-growth analyzer uses the recipient's Food surplus when it has city context, then normalizes Food with no player context. The district Great Person analyzer normalizes the configured type through the player's pseudo-yield weights. Both use timed income discounting.
scope: Byte-matched Windows XP2 reference 324c51e9 and hotfix 092abfbb. Growth RVA 46fac0, city surplus 124060, district Great Person 47b3f0 and default 47b4c0, timed income 528660.
limits: Child analyzers only. Missing-city/default paths have different inputs. Melbourne's prospective Storekeeper roots did not reach a positive value, and the actual Service amount in that city remains unpriced.

title: A complete Dam on a river's floodplain can suppress damage across that flood event
statement: FloodRiver scans the affected river's floodplain for the configured flood-prevention district, checks completion and pillage, and suppresses flood damage when the check passes. The Lua river and floodplain bindings expose the corresponding plot list for comparing legal Dam sites.
scope: Windows XP2 reference 324c51e9 and matching hotfix code. FloodRiver 72d400, GetFloodPreventionDistrict 72e130, Lua bindings 5bcd70 and 5bc970. Shipped Gathering Storm Dam definition and NaturalDisasterPopup call site.
limits: Flood damage path only. Does not price a Dam's other benefits, establish construction eligibility, or prove alternative sites for any city.
